title: Valerian Flower
summary: Alternative Mergrass ingredient for Potion of Mind Reading.

fields.Extraction: Extract 3 Valerian Flowers into Suspension of Mergrass.
fields.Recipe: Mix the suspension with any Sublimate to make Potion of Mind Reading.
fields.Acquisition: Three flowers in the House of Grief garden.
fields.Base value: 5 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
